prompt: Run a full code review of the src folder of this service. There is no git history, so treat every file as changed. Review the backend code, drop weak or speculative findings, then write the consolidated report to code-review-report.md with a Summary (counts by severity), Critical Issues, Important Issues and Suggestions, each finding with file:line. End the report with a line that reads `Verdict: READY FOR CR` or `Verdict: NEEDS FIXES`. Do not change source files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.
